title: probe-paths-that-name-nothing
intention: Every probe-bearing WATCHME spec on a built ticket names a probe file that exists: a moved probe's spec is repointed to where the file now lives, and a PROVED ticket whose probe file is gone or disabled goes to FIXME with the missing probe named — no spec keeps pointing at nothing.
why: Akien, verbatim (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 2): 'if the WATCHME step is incomplete ... then it's a fault and goes back for fixing'
traces_to: Akien W2 (foreground-decisions item 2): 'if the WATCHME step is incomplete ... then it's a fault and goes back for fixing'; ruling a-probe-needs-a-consumer (2026-09-30); Law 7 (a spec naming a missing file is a record of truth that lies); ticket 835b5736bf2b D1.
how: Re-measured 2026-10-02 (scratchpad w2_census.py over CairnCommons/tickets): 50 specs name a missing probe file — 5 on SUPERSEDED/KILLED tickets (terminal, no action), 20 on TICKETME/BUILDME tickets plus 2 at WATCHME with no file anywhere (unbuilt: their own BUILDME/WATCHME builds them, the receiver gate already holds them), 11 MOVED with the file found at a new path (743a09ca5e92, 7fef19d619ae, c23cc599a107, c8661b8defad, ebf5392c8f93, ee2390602f52, f8aab31a917d builder->codemother; 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056, faa51bcfbdfc harbor_master->cairn/machines/harbor_master; fc93d8cd5961 tools/base->tools/bus_client), 4 aider_shim probes now in probes_disabled/ on PROVED tickets (68f1fc073512, 6d3e689b0bf8, d7b4019d2407, e9b0a8d4fb99), and 8 PROVED with no file anywhere (ground_loop 0d16e513ff26, 2f0a6ea8c966, 7ecdce95c42c, 82725b223559, a66af26de84d, b5b5e0483af1, ffc775a09d54; tester 712bac150b3f). For each MOVED spec: rewrite its probe path through cairn artifact write (verb cast). For each disabled or deleted probe on a PROVED ticket: read the ticket and the git log of the deletion, then emit PROVED -> FIXME with missing=['[watchme_probe_absent] <path> — <why it is gone>'] and write workflow_and_state plus fixme through the artifact door. The census becomes a proof: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py (beside watchme_spec.py, the rule a spec answers to) reads the live CairnCommons/tickets and asserts the invariant, written red first against the standing corpus.
falsifier: GREEN when the census finds zero probe-bearing specs naming a missing file on tickets standing at WATCHME-done, PROVEME or PROVED outside FIXME. RED if any moved spec still names the old path, if a FIXME'd ticket's fixme list does not name the absent probe, or if any spec was repointed to a path that does not exist. Horizon: the tester seal of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py.
watchme: none, because the proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py reads the live CairnCommons/tickets on every tester run, and the physics end state (the ticket inspector reds a missing probe file) is named on parent 835b5736bf2b as a later child
children: none, because this is child 1 of 835b5736bf2b and its edits are 11 repoints and 12 FIXME back-edges plus one proof file in cairn/tools/base/proofs
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which specs? Those w2_census.py lists as MOVED (11) and PROVED-with-no-file or probes_disabled (12); the 27 terminal/unbuilt are untouched. (2) Repoint how? load the ticket, replace the old probe path with the found path inside the watchme spec's probe field only, write through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, text, verb='cast', why='<tid>: probe moved <old> -> <new>'). (3) FIXME how? emit(ws, 'FIXME', history_path, state_path, ticket=tid, actor='CC', missing=['[watchme_probe_absent] <path> — <git log reason>']) at the owning component's history.json/state.json, then doc['workflow_and_state']=result, doc['fixme']=[{'n':1,'kind':'watchme_probe_absent','missing':...}], written through the artifact door. (4) Proof? the census as asserts: for every ticket whose cursor is at or past WATCHME and not FIXME/SUPERSEDED/KILLED, every probe path in its watchme spec exists under the repo.

decisions.text: STEP 1 — the proof, already written red at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py: it globs CairnCommons/tickets/*.json (json.loads each, skipping unreadable), takes every watchme spec dict with a 'probe' (watchme may be a dict or a list; the path before '::'), and calls a probe missing when neither <repo>/<probe> nor Path(probe).expanduser() exists; cursor = the first '[A-Z]+' after '[' in workflow_and_state. Teeth: (1) no ticket at [PROVED] names a missing probe; (2) every ticket at [FIXME...] naming a missing probe carries that path in json.dumps(ticket['fixme']); (3) census() reds a fixture PROVED ticket naming a nonexistent path and passes one naming the proof file itself. Red at the pre-build corpus: 22 PROVED tickets.

STEP 2 — repoint the 11 moved specs, old -> new: 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056, faa51bcfbdfc: cairn/devices/harbor_master/probes/<f> -> cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/probes/<f>; 743a09ca5e92, 7fef19d619ae (survey), c23cc599a107 (orient), c8661b8defad, ee2390602f52 (constrain), ebf5392c8f93 (verdict), f8aab31a917d (validate): cairn/devices/builder/machines/<m>/probes/<f> -> cairn/devices/codemother/machines/<m>/probes/<f>; fc93d8cd5961: cairn/tools/base/probes/a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py -> cairn/tools/bus_client/probes/a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py. <f> is unchanged. Before each write, ast.get_docstring of the new file must contain the ticket's title or id (else stop, write nothing). Only the matching spec's 'probe' value changes; the ticket is written with cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', verb='cast', why='<tid>: probe moved <old> -> <new> (693e9f45e6f2)').

STEP 3 — 8 of the 12 dead probes were deleted BY A RULING, so their tickets are SUPERSEDED, not FIXME (a FIXME would demand rebuilding what Akien deleted; precedent ef06b5a49613, which carries superseded_by and supersession). PROVED -> SUPERSEDED is not an emit edge, so like ef06b5a49613 the ticket's workflow_and_state becomes its string with '[PROVED]' replaced by 'PROVED -> [SUPERSEDED]', plus superseded_by and a one-paragraph supersession naming the deleting commit, written through the artifact door (verb cast). superseded_by bae622881f03 (heartbeat-only ruling; probes deleted at 6c7fdb62): 0d16e513ff26, 2f0a6ea8c966, 7ecdce95c42c, a66af26de84d, ffc775a09d54; same, probe loop_not_stale.py deleted earlier at 8d418170: 82725b223559, b5b5e0483af1; superseded_by a48f95c51a41 (one validation record; trail link retired at f745a4dd): 712bac150b3f.

STEP 4 — the 4 aider_shim tickets whose probes sit in cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes_disabled/ (moved there at e50eb534, 2026-08-30, 'aider_shim disabled: encapsulation violation — reaches into inference_domain internals') are real faults and go to FIXME: new = cairn.tools.base.transitions.emit(ticket['workflow_and_state'], 'FIXME', history_path=<comp>/history.json, state_path=<comp>/state.json, ticket=tid, actor='CC', missing=['[watchme_probe_absent] <spec probe path> — <that reason>'], why='693e9f45e6f2: the WATCHME probe is disabled'), comp = cairn/devices/aider_shim for 6d3e689b0bf8, d7b4019d2407, e9b0a8d4fb99 and cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose (its owning intention) for 68f1fc073512; then ticket['workflow_and_state'] = new and ticket['fixme'] = [{'n': 1, 'kind': 'watchme_probe_absent', 'missing': <same text>}], written through the artifact door (verb cast). Then run the proof green, seal it under netns, commit and push both repos.
